features.statement: All text uses a single system-font stack with no web fonts loaded.
Body text is about 17px with generous line height around 1.65.
Headings are bold, centered, and large (64px H1, ~37px H2), with tight negative letter-spacing.
Headings use Title Case throughout.
Header is semi-transparent white with backdrop blur, acting as a sticky overlay.
Hero is a full-width dark navy-to-indigo gradient band with a lighter radial glow and white centered headline.
Primary call-to-action is a fully rounded cyan pill button with dark text.
Cards have rounded corners and thin light borders with no shadows.
FAQ-style content is shown as stacked cards in a narrow centered column, all answers expanded without accordion behavior.
Repeated content blocks are marked up as article elements, with H3 questions and H5 footer column headings.
Body answer text is muted slate gray while headings are near-black navy.
Inline body links are violet and underlined.
Copy is short and restrained, with no emoji or exclamation marks, and occasional en/em dashes.
Sections alternate between white and pale gray-blue background bands.
A three-column grid of pale cards each has a violet top border accent.
Secondary links are small, uppercase, letter-spaced, violet text with a trailing arrow glyph.
Press logos appear as an evenly spaced row of grayscale raster images of uniform size.
Footer is solid dark navy with multiple columns of plain text links, no icons, repeating the header nav.
Palette is navy and indigo with violet accents, one cyan CTA, and light lavender-gray text on dark.
Corners are mostly square; rounding is reserved for cards, a media box, and a few pills.
A large rounded video placeholder with dark gradient and centered translucent circular play icon is used instead of real video.
Content sits in a centered ~1000px container with narrower 680px columns and generous ~100px section padding.
Motion is limited to simple CSS transitions, with no animations, transforms, or scripts.
Styling lives in one inline style block with few semantic class names, minimal ARIA and no structured data.
Navigation and footer links are marked up as lists.
